_doc: patch_quest_showcase.py: the rewards on show in the quest hall's alcoves made to match what each quest gives (owner 2026-11-02). quest: the name of the hall_hunts.csv row of kind quest. replace: [on show, given] item ids swapped in place. add: item ids put on the alcove's emptiest cell. sign: the new text of the alcove's sign.

quests.why: the chests give the thorn spitter (16111, uid 9010), not the royal crossbow
rewards.lua (uids 1300-1308) gives the master archer's armor and the spellbook of dark mysteries, not the paladin armor
the chest (uid 10545) gives the plain soft boots, not the regenerating ones
the third chest (uid 2214) gives a demon shield
a chest (uid 1299) gives a guardian halberd
a chest (uid 42016) gives a royal scale robe

quests.quest: Astro Mage / Astro Warrior Outfit Quest
quests.sign:
Astro Quest

The quest's chests give the Astro Mage and Astro Warrior outfits.
The items on show are not a quest reward: the Astro King drops them by chance (a loot bag on one kill in two).
quests.why: the items on show come only from the boss's loot bag (Enhanced_loot.lua, chance 5000 of 10000)
